rows.summary: Typography → Name Font and Heading Font (settings.nameFont / headingFont: a picker font or a saved custom font; 'Same as text' = unset) print the name (every template, the cover letter's letterhead) and the section titles (main column, the Sidebar's About Me and side-column titles) in fonts of their own, in the PDF and in Word; one that cannot load prints in Noto Sans and is named in the font-fallback notice ('Lato and Inter could not be loaded …'); the Typography ↺ resets both. Title Spacing now reaches the Sidebar's side-column titles (PDF and Word). The Word file's font table names an installed stand-in for every font it uses — Arial for a sans, Georgia for a serif (w:altName + PANOSE + family), none for Georgia — and Typography says so ('Word does not embed fonts: where they are not installed, Inter shows as Arial …'). Unset, the PDF prints as before.

issues: The 93 panel tests left view.unmount() unawaited, so CI failed 93-word-font-fallback with 'window is not defined' after the test ended (and its failfirst 'with the fix' step).
Cypress 13-regressions-fonts: Typography is longer now, and after type() the Bebas Neue chip sat under the editor tabs; it failed be.visible.
The name is now measured in its own font (fitFontSize via nameFamily), but no test covers that: Liberation Sans and Noto Sans bold are too close in width to tell apart reliably.
fixedByReviewer: 32074e8: both panel tests await unmount; the Cypress spec scrolls the chip into view before checking it is visible (the check itself is unchanged).
